presets.label: Google Drive
presets.blurb: Open the markdown files in your Google Drive.

setup.heading: Google Drive needs an OAuth client of your own
setup.why: Inkju does not ship one. A client secret inside an app anyone can download is not a secret, so this stays yours — nothing about your Drive passes through us.
steps: Open the Google Cloud console and create a project, or pick one you already have.
Enable the Google Drive API for it.
Configure the OAuth consent screen, adding yourself as a test user.
Create an OAuth client ID of type Desktop app.
Copy the client ID and client secret into the two boxes below.
setup.caveat: Google's Drive MCP server is part of the Workspace Developer Preview Program. It can change, and it may not be available to every account yet.
